metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU SHEUNG v. PA LING LOGISTICS CO LTD

injuries.description: Fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula with two 1 cm wounds over the fracture
Contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement
Left leg numbness, stiffness and pain; unable to walk for long period, difficulty in squatting, slow on stairs; pain extends to left knee
Left leg weakness, difficulty in carrying heavy items
Occasional left leg cramps during sleep
Multiple surgical scars at left leg including 6 scars at shin and anterior knee, including 3 cm scar at anterior knee and 7 cm scar at distal shin
Mild left knee stiffness over flexion and mild left ankle stiffness over dorsiflexion and plantarflexion

losses.description: Left leg numbness, stiffness and pain; unable to walk for long period, difficulty in squatting, slow on stairs; reduced efficiency and capacity on prolonged driving and heavy lifting
Multiple surgical scars at left leg including 6 scars at shin and anterior knee, 3 cm scar at anterior knee and 7 cm scar at distal shin
Unable to return to pre-accident employment; reduced efficiency and capacity at work, handicapped in open labour market
Disabilities affected plaintiff's temper and social life in a negative way

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Shing Ching v Hong Kong District Security Ltd and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture at right tibia and fibula; wound debridement and external skeletal fixator, followed by removal of external fixator and intramedullary nailing; skin graft wound infection; confined to wheelchair for 4 months; sick leave about 11 months

comparable_cases.case_name: Ko Chu Keung v Temmuk Engineering Co Ltd And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture of right tibia and fibula with 10cm x 4cm contaminated open wound with exposed bone; intramedullary nailing and plating; second debridement; sick leave 24 months

comparable_cases.case_name: Sukhdeep Singh v Chow Kin Hung And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fractured distal tibia and fibula of right leg; open reduction and internal fixation of fibula and nailing of tibia; bone graft from right knee; re-admitted for removal of surgical implant; sick leave 20 months
